observed_existing_substrate.notable_staleness: Latest observed perception sources in the endpoint response are from 2026-04-09 or earlier, so they cannot be counted as current live lab openability evidence.

lesson.title: Use existing perception source records as a starting map, not live lab inventory success
lesson.rule: Registered perception sources with stale last_seen_at timestamps prove prior capability, not current camera/microphone/arm-camera readiness.
resolution_pattern: Read current perception sources to seed the inventory candidate list.
For each candidate camera/microphone/arm-camera path, run a current openability/freshness probe or record a precise blocker.
Republish MIM_LAB_SENSOR_INVENTORY.latest.json with per-resource status, last_seen_at, freshness, openability, and failure reason.
Only advance to camera cycling when at least the available cameras have fresh current evidence or explicit blockers.

required_next_mim_action: Connect the lab sensor inventory task to the existing perception source/event endpoints and republish current per-device evidence or exact blockers.
tod_codex_boundary: monitor and guide only; do not implement camera, microphone, TTS, human memory, or object recognition work for MIM
